profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer on the Fullstack team at Backblaze. Specializes in Java backend development for the Computer Backup product. Extensive experience with distributed systems and concurrency for handling large amounts of data. 

Previously a Computer Science student at Stanford University, with a specialization in Artificial Intelligence.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Developer on the fullstack team with a focus on backend Java development for the Computer Backup Product. Likes giving tech talks and mentoring new engineers. 

Notable work includes:
- Implemented optimized deletion process for obsolete backup data. Deletes ~900TB per day. Deletes obsolete data months before the previously existing process would have. Estimated cost savings of $1.2 million yearly. 
- Built an in-house global rate limiting system for B2 Cloud Storage API calls. Significantly improved ability to protect company resources from malicious actors or accounts that overuse resources.
- Diagnosed issue with deletion processes resulting in storage of >100 PB of unnecessary data. Implemented solution, deleting the excess data and saving $X million yearly in storage costs. 
- Designed and orchestrated the migration of >300TB of critical backup metadata from expensive storage hardware to B2 Cloud Storage. Removed the need for expensive storage hardware (>$100,000 per production cluster) to store such metadata.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description: Worked on software engineering and data science teams, building probabilistic models for natural language analysis and call analytics.

positions.title: Senior Section Leader
positions.description:
Led student sections in the CS106A and CS106B introductory programming courses at Stanford.
Taught weekly sessions, helped debug students’ code, and graded assignments.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Back end software engineer for a new audit trail visualization feature on Axon's online evidence management platform.

positions.title: Summer Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I programmed statistical analysis of hard drive failures in Backblaze's 100PB data storage system, and built a competitive analysis lab.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered in Peru during the summer of 2018. Worked for 4 weeks at Picaflor House, an after-school program for children in the village of Oropesa. Additionally worked for 2 weeks at an animal rehabilitation center in the Amazon Rainforest near Puerto Maldonado.

projects.title: Politronix
projects.description: Politronix is a real-time sentiment analysis website for political topics on Twitter. We pull data from Twitter, use our own sentiment analysis algorithm to evaluate how positively or negatively people feel towards given topics, and display the results in a simple website.

projects.title: A Detailed Computational Model of Tree Growth
projects.description: Created a computational model of tree growth that predicts if and how a tree will grow given certain environmental conditions. Won the National Siemens Competition in Math, Science and Technology for a grand prize of $100,000 (1800 submissions nationwide). Also received a Third Award at the Intel International Science and Engineering Fair and the Best Student Physiological Paper at the Botanical Society of America 2014 Annual Conference.

publications.title: A Detailed Computational Model of Tree Growth
publications.publisher: Botanical Society of America Annual Conference
